content.text:
nemotron-omni-vision — available · ai/text
good for: asking a question ABOUT an image — what is in it, what is wrong with it, does it match a brief
avoid for: generating or editing an image (this returns text, never media), and video or audio understanding (use marlin-video / wizper)
price: ~$0.0063/tokens (static estimate; list_capabilities has the live meter)
latency: p50 3s / p95 5s (static)
requires a image input (pass it as source_url)
invoke: create_media { action: "analyze", model_override: "nemotron-omni-vision", … }

structuredContent.name: nemotron-omni-vision

sla.note: static estimate from n=6 (nvidia nemotron-3-nano-omni/vision); fast enough to run sync

args.prompt: What is the main object in this image? Answer in one or two words.

image_url.note: Public https URL of the image to reason about. Required by the provider — this capability cannot run without one. Pass it as `image_url`; `source_url` is refused by the required-input check, which runs before aliasing.

output.note: the model's answer as text; no media is produced
